description: This file contains the PHP class 'Filter' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog', which manages CRUD operations and retrieval of filter data for the catalog module in an OpenCart backend API.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A model class responsible for handling filter data in the catalog section, including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval of filter records and their descriptions.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Creates a new filter entry in the database, adds descriptions for multiple languages, clears related cache, and returns the new filter's ID.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Updates an existing filter's group ID and sort order, replaces descriptions in multiple languages, clears cache.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes a filter and its descriptions from the database, and clears the cache.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific filter, including its descriptions, based on filter ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filters with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination as specified by input data.

methods.name: getTotalFilters
methods.description: Returns the total count of filters in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a filter in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific filter ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions that are in a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given filter ID, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter descriptions in a specified language.
